name: Chai Discovery
description: Chai Discovery is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Chai Discovery is a privately held artificial intelligence drug discovery company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $400 million Series C round announced on July 14, 2026, valued the company at $3.8 billion.

Founded in 2024 and based in San Francisco, Chai Discovery develops AI models that predict the structure of biological molecules and design new ones, including antibodies, for use in drug development. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: The Series C valuation is as announced by the company, and the Series B valuation is as reported in the press. The Series A valuation is as reported by the Financial Times, and the seed valuation is as reported by Bloomberg.
round_notes: Index Ventures led the Series C, which SiliconANGLE reported brought the company's total funding to $630 million.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Index Ventures led the Series C, with participation from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia Capital and Dimension. General Catalyst and Oak HC/FT co-led the Series B, Menlo Ventures led the Series A, and Thrive Capital, OpenAI and Dimension led the seed round. Other investors include Bain Capital Ventures, Battery Ventures, Baillie Gifford and DCVC.
spv_sentence: No special purpose vehicles naming Chai Discovery appear in SEC Form D filings.
sources: Sources: Chai Discovery's announcements of its Series C, Series B, Series A and seed round; a SiliconANGLE report dated July 14, 2026; reports by Financial Times and Bloomberg; and SEC Form D filings.
